description: Activity files the verdicts ("marked vein … Dead end/Proven") under Status changes and handoffs, but the resolution of that same verdict conflict ("resolved conflicting status on vein … Kept Dead end") only under Goals and veins. Neither filter tells the whole verdict story.
expected: A status resolve sits with the status changes it settles (or both sit under Goals and veins).
actual: Status changes: 23 rows, no resolve row. Goals and veins: the resolve row, but no verdicts.
suggested_fix: Put goal/vein resolves of the status field in the same group as goal/vein status updates.

description: In the conflict disclosure, the Keep buttons are pushed to the far right of the 844 px column, about 550 px from the author and value they keep, and have different widths (Keep Dead end vs Keep Proven), so their left edges are ragged.
expected: Each Keep button sits next to its value, or buttons share a width and left edge.
actual: Value at x≈473, buttons at x≈1022–1142.
suggested_fix: Drop the space-between on .record-choice, or give it a grid with a fixed button column.

description: The disputed pill "Dead end or Proven" replaces the select and looks like a control, but it is a non-interactive span. Clicking it does nothing; the way to resolve is a separate disclosure below.
expected: Clicking the pill opens the matching Conflicting edits disclosure.
actual: No response; focus falls to the goal article.
suggested_fix: Render the pill as a button that toggles and focuses the disclosure.

description: At 390 px the Conflicting edits summary becomes display:flex (44 px touch target), which removes the ▸ disclosure marker. It reads as static amber text with no sign that it expands.
expected: A visible expand chevron at every width.
actual: No marker on mobile; desktop shows ▸.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit chevron element (or keep display:list-item) in the mobile summary style.
